narrative.intro: SLS Federal Services has $2.4B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date, recorded across 3 awards with an average award size of $793M. The obligations are concentrated in FY26: FY26 obligations total $2.4B, and earlier fiscal years have no listed obligations in the available rankings. The current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. Award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligation amounts. The company’s profile shows a small number of high-dollar awards rather than many smaller contracts. Contracting officers and competitors should note the concentration of obligations into a few awards when evaluating market opportunity and capture strategy. The available dataset does not include buyer agency names, product or service descriptions, or expiring-contract entries, so further procurement-level research will be required to map spend to specific agencies, requirements, and upcoming recompetition dates.
